statement: Ordinary Rosati-fixed degree-g real multiplication has delta(A)=1 for the full integer ring; for any such order every prime divisor of delta divides its index, in all positive characteristics
depends_on: C.4v; C.4j; Dwork-Ogus1986 Theorem1.4p115; C.4n; C.4p
notes: Actual splitting for ordinary surfaces with odd order index and ordinary threefolds with index prime to6, including p2 andp3. Canonical lift preserves action and polarization; no arbitrary nonordinary lifting assertion.
